name: M9 minimal medium + 400 mM methanol + 0.1 g/L yeast extract (PMC9871363)
description: M9 minimal medium + 400 mM methanol + 0.1 g/L yeast extract — medium reported in PMC9871363 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC9871363 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'M9' expanded to standard composition: M9 minimal medium (Sambrook & Russell 2001): Na2HPO4, KH2PO4, NaCl, NH4Cl, MgSO4, CaCl2 + carbon source.
provenance.verification_evidence: M9 minimal medium is described with '400 mM methanol, ... and 100 μg/mL ampicillin at 37°C and 200 rpm'; low-yeast-extract variant is 'methanol with 0.1 g/L yeast extract'. All cultures grown aerobically (200 rpm shaking, 37°C). M9 base per liter: Na2HPO4·12H2O 17.1 g, KH2PO4 3 g, NH4Cl 1 g, NaCl 0.5 g, MgSO4·7H2O 2 mM, CaCl2 0.1 mM, trace elements (FeCl3, ZnCl2, CoCl2, Na2MoO4, CuCl2, H3BO3).

Yeast extract.citation: Yeast extract supplies free amino acids, B-vitamins (thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, pantothenate, pyridoxine, folate, biotin, B12), nucleotides and minerals — BD Bionutrient Technical Manual (3rd ed.); Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media (CRC Press, 4th ed. 2010).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
